from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityGraduationData(BaseModel):
    university_name: str = Field(description="Name of the university")
    six_year_graduation_rate: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for the Fall 2015 cohort as a percentage; None if not found in document")
    document_index: int = Field(description="Index of the document in the provided dataset")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityGraduationData]
